quote: In this work, we focus on solving time-sensitive factual questions with LLMs.

Experimental evaluation on multiple time-sensitive question-answering datasets shows that our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines... We consider several widely-used temporal reasoning datasets: TimeQA, TempQuestions and TimeQuestions.
In this work we propose a novel approach, QAaP (Question Answering as Programming), to tackle the challenges posed by time-sensitive factual questions.
outputs: Generated answer strings (e.g., entity names) for time‑constrained factual questions

The outputs are answers to time-sensitive factual questions, generated through a process of parsing questions and context into code, extracting relevant information, and selecting the best-matching answer using programming-based verification.

quote: Specifically, it achieves a remarkable enhancement of 13.9%, 14.5%, 10.5%, and 8.6% in exact match scores on TimeQA-Easy, TimeQA-Hard, TempQuestions, and TimeQuestions, respectively.
